Desc.SourceString:
觉醒后，残虹的「普通攻击：燎原」、「普通攻击：绰影」、「极限反击：虚徊」、强化「变轨技能：绯影闪」 、强化「变轨技能：离魂错」均能扩散持续伤害效果，且常态获得<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ZankouShou">「狩」</>与<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ZankouHuo">「惑」</>增益效果。二者持续生效，不会有延迟清除，也不会因残虹离场或改变攻击形态而清除，仅在残虹阵亡时移除。
<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ZankouShou">「狩」</>使残虹自身造成的伤害提升至<NumGreen>40%</>，<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ZankouHuo">「惑」</>使全队持续伤害的暴击伤害提升至<NumGreen>50%</>。
Desc.LocalizedString:
Allows Wildfire, Flickering Shadow, Voidstep, enhanced Sanguine Dash, and enhanced Soulcross to spread DoT effects upon Awakening. Grants Zankou <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ZankouShou">Hunt</> and <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ZankouHuo">Delusion</> at all times. Keeps both buffs active without delayed removal and prevents them from being removed when Zankou leaves the field or switches forms. Removes them only when Zankou is defeated.
The DMG bonus granted to Zankou by <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ZankouShou">Hunt</> increases to <NumGreen>40%</>. The DoT Crit DMG bonus granted to the whole team by <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ZankouHuo">Delusion</> increases to <NumGreen>50%</>.

Desc.SourceString: 残虹作为环合双方之一参与触发「浊燃」或「覆纹」时，可积累<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ZankouStack">「蓄焰」</>，使下一次「极轨终结：焚天烬灭舞」造成的最终伤害提升<NumGreen>150%</>；<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ZankouStack">「蓄焰」</>可以在「极轨终结：焚天烬灭舞」尚未进入可释放状态时提前积累，最多1层。
Desc.LocalizedString: Builds up <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ZankouStack">Kindling</> whenever Zankou participates in a Cycle that triggers Scorch or Hexed, increasing the Final DMG dealt by the next Inferno Flamenco by <NumGreen>150%</>. Allows <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ZankouStack">Kindling</> to accumulate even before Inferno Flamenco becomes available, up to 1 stack.

Desc.SourceString: <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ZankouShou">「狩」</>额外使残虹的抗打断能力提升<NumGreen>50%</>；<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ZankouHuo">「惑」</>额外使残虹每秒回复自身最大生命值<NumGreen>4%</>的生命。
Desc.LocalizedString: <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ZankouShou">Hunt</> increases Zankou's Resistance to Interruptions by an additional <NumGreen>50%</>. <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ZankouHuo">Delusion</> restores HP equal to <NumGreen>4%</> of her Max HP per second.

Desc.SourceString:
当「极轨终结：焚天烬灭舞」进入可释放状态时，立刻激活「极轨终结：血宴入梦时」。
此外，<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ZankouStack">「蓄焰」</>的增伤效果也将作用于「极轨终结：血宴入梦时」，释放「极轨终结：血宴入梦时」共享<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ZankouStack">「蓄焰」</>增伤效果层数。
Desc.LocalizedString:
Activates Bloodfeast Reverie immediately when Inferno Flamenco becomes available.
Applies the DMG Bonus from <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ZankouStack">Kindling</> to Bloodfeast Reverie, which shares the same <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ZankouStack">Kindling</> stacks with Inferno Flamenco.

Desc.SourceString:
强化「变轨技能：绯影闪」首次命中可倾陷目标时，必定使该目标进入倾陷状态。该效果对每个目标在单场战斗中最多生效<NumGreen>1</>次，对角色均衡模式下的Boss不生效。
此外，残虹在队伍时，全队造成的倾陷伤害提升<NumGreen>300%</>。
Desc.LocalizedString:
Guarantees that the first Breakable target hit by enhanced Sanguine Dash enters the Broken state. Triggers only <NumGreen>once</> per target per battle and does not affect bosses in Character Balance Mode.
Increases all allies' Break DMG by <NumGreen>300%</> while Zankou is on the team.

Desc.SourceString: <TextHLT>「灭」</>最后<NumGreen>1</>段攻击命中单个目标时，根据命中目标持有的所有持续伤害总层数，每层使本段攻击对该目标造成的伤害提升<NumGreen>12%</>，最多提升<NumGreen>240%</>；命中多名目标时，则分别根据各个目标自身持有的所有持续伤害总层数，单独计算对各个目标的增伤效果。
Desc.LocalizedString: Increases the DMG dealt by the <NumGreen>final</> hit of <TextHLT>Oblivion</> to a single target by <NumGreen>12%</> for each DoT stack on that target, up to <NumGreen>240%</>. Calculates the DMG Bonus separately for each target when multiple targets are hit, based on the total number of DoT stacks on each target.

Desc.SourceString: 「普通攻击：燎原」、「普通攻击：魇舞」、「变轨技能：绯影闪」、「变轨技能：离魂错」、「极轨终结：焚天烬灭舞」和「极轨终结：血宴入梦时」的技能等级提升<NumGreen>1</>级。残虹的「极轨终结：血宴入梦时」和「极轨终结：焚天烬灭舞」技能倍率提升<NumGreen>20%</>。
Desc.LocalizedString: Increases the skill levels of Wildfire, Nightmare Waltz, Sanguine Dash, Soulcross, Inferno Flamenco, and Bloodfeast Reverie by <NumGreen>1</>. Increases the DMG Ratios of Bloodfeast Reverie and Inferno Flamenco by <NumGreen>20%</>.

Desc.SourceString:
残虹对目标造成伤害后，使自身攻击力提升<NumGreen>40%</>，持续<NumGreen>20</>秒。该效果不可叠加，重复触发时刷新持续时间。
处于「浊燃」状态下的目标被击败后，残虹获得持续<NumGreen>60</>秒的强化效果。强化期间，残虹对目标施加持续伤害效果时，立即使该目标的「浊燃」达到层数上限。再次击败处于「浊燃」状态下的目标时，刷新该强化效果的持续时间。
Desc.LocalizedString:
Increases Zankou's ATK by <NumGreen>40%</> for <NumGreen>20</>s after she deals damage. This effect does not stack. Resets the duration when triggered again.
Grants an enhanced effect for <NumGreen>60</>s when a target afflicted with Scorch is defeated. Maxes out the target's Scorch stacks whenever Zankou inflicts DoTs on them during the enhancement. Refreshes the enhancement's duration whenever another target afflicted with Scorch is defeated.
